locked_door.description: A damaged Memory Card showing a door the museum refuses to label.

calling_name.description: A damaged Memory Card holding a voice just before it becomes a name.

ink_hands.description: A damaged Memory Card stained by records copied too many times.

bell_under_water.description: A damaged Memory Card where a bell rings from below a black surface.

bell_saint.description: A town prayed for mercy. The museum preserved the prayer, the fear, and the bell. It forgot to preserve the difference between healing and punishment.

the_empty_train.description: The platform remained. The announcement remained. The schedule remained. The passengers did not.

the_uncatalogued_child.description: No birth record. No death record. No exhibit origin. Still alive.
